artDirection.tone: cinematic realistic Korean high-rise construction site
artDirection.worldPriority: site-first, HUD-free, readable at phone scale

routeContract.semantic: temporary logistics and risk-propagation circulation spine
notes: The route must read as believable temporary site circulation, not a game track painted on the ground.
Curbs, cones, barriers, fencing and surface changes may suggest flow, but no baked arrows or UI symbols.
Large props must not occlude the route centerline.

pads.visualCue: small clear hardstand beside inbound lane; gatehouse/fence context nearby
clear verge between circulation lane and material handling edge
open slab or temporary deck edge with long sightline
clear refuge hardstand near a high-conflict route bend

pads.worldContext: lifting exclusion / central workface control point
pads.visualCue: clear control apron beside structure/tower-crane work zone
clear pad near pump/material staging but outside vehicle swept path
clear access apron near final workface and vertical access

notes: Pads must look like plausible construction control/staging hardstands, not circular sci-fi sockets.
No permanent prop may occupy the central 44 logical-pixel radius around a pad.
The art must support any PULSE/BURST/CONTROL/SENSOR runtime overlay at every pad.

zones.purpose: temporary office/welfare and site administration edge
main vehicle/pedestrian entry and security gate
material logistics transition and segregated circulation
upper slab/material handling and crane observation workface
central structure/core and major conflict zone
pump truck, plant and service staging zone
active high-rise workface and final controlled access
visual depth and secondary storage buffer

compositionRules: Keep the central serpentine circulation spine visually legible within two seconds.
Use realistic Korean high-rise construction-site materials and temporary works.
Foreground/midground/background depth must be readable despite near-orthographic projection.
Major vertical masses must stay outside pad keepout circles and must not visually erase route bends.
The board should feel like one continuous worksite, not six disconnected diorama tiles.
Route bends at x=180, x=450 and x=720 are deliberate visual landmarks and must remain easy to track.
The west entry and east final workface must read as different operational contexts.
No logos, company names, HUD, score text, hazard icons or game labels in world art.
mobileReadabilityRules: At 390px portrait camera scale, each local sector must still show at least one route segment plus nearby pad context.
Avoid micro-detail that disappears below 2-3 device pixels.
Use large material/light/value blocks to separate road, slab, structure and staging areas.
Critical interactable clearings must have strong ground contrast without glowing game rings.
